external_primary_references.title: SciPy minimize SLSQP official reference
external_primary_references.supports: SLSQP minimizes a scalar function with constraints; ftol/termination and KKT approximation details are optimization diagnostics, not pose accuracy or global feasibility certification.
external_primary_references.use: API semantics only; current executed library/source versions remain bound by experiment protocol.

external_primary_references.title: OpenCV PnP official reference
external_primary_references.supports: PnP solves 3D-2D reprojection geometry; P3P can have multiple roots and generic PnP can expose alternative solutions.
external_primary_references.use: Explains objective/branch structure, not a claim that the current joint OT problem inherits global optimality from a PnP initializer.
